lines.zh: 我一步压出一个坑，沙子往下陷。
lines.en: Each step leaves a pit, and the sand sinks beneath it.

lines.zh: 炮管随步子晃，撞在护栏上。
lines.en: The barrel sways with my stride and knocks the rail.

lines.zh: 我挪得很慢，地面先替我让路。
lines.en: I move slowly, and the ground gives way before me.

lines.zh: 铁甲磨着铁甲，走一路响一路。
lines.en: Plate grinds on plate, and the noise follows me.

lines.zh: 我转身要先停，再分两次转。
lines.en: To turn, I stop first, then turn in two stages.

lines.zh: 甲板在脚下弯，我不敢快走。
lines.en: The deck bows under me, so I dare not hurry.

lines.zh: 我拖着炮架，绳结勒进肩膀。
lines.en: I drag the carriage, and the rope bites my shoulder.

lines.zh: 火绳在腰上晃，我盯着别看它。
lines.en: The match cord swings at my waist, and I look away from it.

lines.zh: 我踩碎一块船板，没停下来道歉。
lines.en: I crush a deck board and do not stop to apologize.

lines.zh: 我横着过舱门，肩膀擦掉一层漆。
lines.en: I cross the hatch sideways and scrape off a layer of paint.

lines.zh: 每走一步，我都在估还有几步到射程。
lines.en: Every step, I reckon how many remain to firing range.

lines.zh: 我走起来像打桩，一沉一沉。
lines.en: I walk like a pile driver, sinking with each step.

lines.zh: 潮水推我，我照旧走自己的线。
lines.en: The tide pushes me, and I hold my own line.

lines.zh: 我绕开松软的沙，怕炮陷进去。
lines.en: I skirt the soft sand, afraid the gun will sink.

lines.zh: 我把炮口压低，免得撞到桅杆。
lines.en: I lower my muzzle so it clears the mast.

lines.zh: 鞋底在湿甲板上打滑，我停一下。
lines.en: My soles slip on the wet deck; I stop a moment.

lines.zh: 我擦炮膛，擦到铁都发亮。
lines.en: I swab the bore until the iron shines.

lines.zh: 火绳有点潮，我搁在腋下捂着。
lines.en: The match cord is damp, so I tuck it under my arm.

lines.zh: 我检查药包，一包一包捏过。
lines.en: I check the powder charges, squeezing each one.

lines.zh: 没事的时候，我数着炮架上的钉。
lines.en: With nothing to do, I count the nails in the carriage.

lines.zh: 我半蹲着，让膝盖少受点力。
lines.en: I half crouch to spare my knees.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻炮口，还有昨天的味道。
lines.en: I sniff the muzzle, and yesterday is still in it.

lines.zh: 我把炮弹滚回原位，滚了三趟。
lines.en: I roll the shot back into place, three trips of it.

lines.zh: 海风一吹，我的铁甲就凉透了。
lines.en: The sea wind cuts through and chills my plate.

lines.zh: 我试着抬手，抬到一半停住。
lines.en: I try to raise a hand and stop halfway.

lines.zh: 炮膛里还压着一发，我不急。
lines.en: There's still a shot in my barrel; I'm in no hurry.

lines.zh: 我敲了敲自己的胸甲，听声音。
lines.en: I knock on my breastplate and listen.

lines.zh: 我把沙从炮闩缝里抠出来。
lines.en: I dig sand out of the breech seam.

lines.zh: 我坐着不动，像一门上了架的炮。
lines.en: I sit still, like a gun already mounted.

lines.zh: 我哼了半句船歌，剩下的忘了。
lines.en: I hum half a sea shanty and forget the rest.

lines.zh: 我低下炮口，对着你的方向看了看。
lines.en: I lower the muzzle and look along your direction.

lines.zh: 你比我想的矮，射程得往回收。
lines.en: You are shorter than I thought; I shorten the range.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，像在量一门靶子的宽度。
lines.en: I stare as if measuring a target's width.

lines.zh: 你的铁甲比我薄，我记下了。
lines.en: Your plate is thinner than mine, and I note it.

lines.zh: 我抬头时，脖子发出一声闷响。
lines.en: When I raise my head, my neck gives a dull crack.

lines.zh: 你站在我的射界里，还没察觉。
lines.en: You stand in my field of fire without noticing.

lines.zh: 我歪头，让一只眼从铁缝里看你。
lines.en: I tilt my head so one eye can see you through the seam.

lines.zh: 你手里那点火，我认得。
lines.en: That little flame in your hand, I know it.

lines.zh: 我看了很久，才决定不动。
lines.en: I look a long time before deciding not to move.

lines.zh: 我在算，一炮够不够。
lines.en: I am calculating whether one shot will do.

lines.zh: 这一下打凹了甲，没打穿。
lines.en: That dented the plate without piercing it.

lines.zh: 我闷哼一声，声从胸里滚出来。
lines.en: I grunt, and the sound rolls out of my chest.

lines.zh: 血和铁锈混在一起，分不清。
lines.en: Blood and rust mix until I cannot tell them apart.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，把炮口重新对准。
lines.en: I step back half a pace and re-aim the muzzle.

lines.zh: 疼是慢的，像我这具身子一样慢。
lines.en: The pain is slow, as slow as this body of mine.

lines.zh: 你砍在关节上，我弯了一下。
lines.en: You strike a joint, and I bend a little.

lines.zh: 我摸了摸凹处，记下这笔。
lines.en: I touch the dent and mark it down.

lines.zh: 炮弹滑了一下，我赶紧扶住。
lines.en: A shot slips, and I catch it quickly.

lines.zh: 挨打我不怕，怕的是炮哑了。
lines.en: I do not fear blows; I fear a silent gun.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，火绳还在烧。
lines.en: I raise my head; the match cord still burns.

lines.zh: 火药的味道，比食物更让我过去。
lines.en: The smell of powder draws me more than food.

lines.zh: 你抱着那包东西，是药还是盐？
lines.en: That bundle you hold: powder or salt?

lines.zh: 给我一块铁，我就安静一会儿。
lines.en: Give me a piece of iron and I will settle for a while.

lines.zh: 我闻见油，炮闩正缺这个。
lines.en: I smell oil, and the breech is short of it.

lines.zh: 你举起的火把，让我有点走神。
lines.en: That torch you raise makes me lose focus.

lines.zh: 那捆绳正好，能绑住炮架。
lines.en: That coil of rope would do to lash the carriage.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的背包，形状像药包。
lines.en: I watch your pack; it has the shape of a charge.

lines.zh: 你敲一下铁，我的头就转过去。
lines.en: Tap iron once and my head turns toward it.

lines.zh: 一桶黑的、会炸的东西，我最想要。
lines.en: A black cask of something explosive is what I want most.

lines.zh: 别晃，我怕自己伸手去拿。
lines.en: Do not wave it; I fear my hand will reach out.

lines.zh: 你撞在我腿上，像撞在一堵铁墙。
lines.en: You hit my leg as if against an iron wall.

lines.zh: 我一侧身，你被挤到船舷上。
lines.en: I turn my flank, and you are pressed to the rail.

lines.zh: 我停不住，冲过去的惯性太大。
lines.en: I cannot stop; the momentum carries me through.

lines.zh: 你从我炮架下钻过去，我慢了半拍。
lines.en: You duck under my carriage, and I react half a beat late.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，踩到你的脚。
lines.en: I take one step back and find your foot.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我的炮弹滚了两颗。
lines.en: At that bump, two shot roll loose.

lines.zh: 我伸手扶你，力道没控制好。
lines.en: I reach to steady you and misjudge the force.

lines.zh: 别站在我转身的那一边。
lines.en: Do not stand on the side I turn toward.

lines.zh: 我的铁甲磕到你，声音很闷。
lines.en: My plate knocks against you with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 我挪开，给你留出一条窄道。
lines.en: I shift aside and leave you a narrow gap.

lines.zh: 两门炮靠在一起，铁碰铁地响。
lines.en: Two guns lean together, iron ringing on iron.

lines.zh: 她比我轻，靠过来时不怎么晃。
lines.en: She is lighter than I am and hardly rocks against me.

lines.zh: 我们互相检查药包，谁也没说话。
lines.en: We check each other's charges without a word.

lines.zh: 这门亲事，是船长点头的。
lines.en: The captain nodded at this match.

lines.zh: 我替她擦炮膛，擦得比自己那门细。
lines.en: I swab her bore more carefully than my own.

lines.zh: 我们并排架着，朝着同一个方向。
lines.en: We mount side by side, aimed the same way.

lines.zh: 她的火绳比我的干，我借了点火。
lines.en: Her match cord is drier than mine, so I borrow a light.

lines.zh: 生下来的小炮，得两个人抬。
lines.en: The little guns we produce take two to lift.

lines.zh: 她说我太慢，我说炮不怕慢。
lines.en: She says I am slow; I say a gun need not hurry.

lines.zh: 我们守着同一段海，各看一边。
lines.en: We guard the same stretch of sea, one side each.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡炮弹，弯到一半卡住。
lines.en: I bend for a shot and stick halfway down.

lines.zh: 我捡起那颗铁球，掂了掂，正合适。
lines.en: I pick up the iron ball, weigh it, and find it right.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的药包，我一律收走。
lines.en: Any charge dropped on the ground, I collect.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块碎甲，先塞进缝里。
lines.en: I pick up a shard of plate and jam it into a gap.

lines.zh: 这枚钉子我用得上，别跟我抢。
lines.en: I can use that nail, so do not contest it.

lines.zh: 我捡起火绳，吹了吹灰。
lines.en: I pick up the match cord and blow off the ash.

lines.zh: 我蹲下去，动作比站起来还慢。
lines.en: I crouch, which is slower than standing up.

lines.zh: 我捡起你的刀，看了看，还你。
lines.en: I pick up your blade, look it over, and hand it back.

lines.zh: 那桶东西太重，我单手就提了。
lines.en: That cask is heavy, and I lift it one-handed.

lines.zh: 我把捡的塞进腰袋，袋子鼓起来。
lines.en: I stuff my finds into the belt pouch until it bulges.

lines.zh: 你进了射界，我就开始算提前量。
lines.en: You enter my field of fire, and I start leading the shot.

lines.zh: 我把炮口转过去，这就是回答。
lines.en: I swing the muzzle around, and that is my answer.

lines.zh: 目标够大，不用瞄太久。
lines.en: The target is big enough; no long aim needed.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，是在等你站定。
lines.en: I hold still, waiting for you to stop moving.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，我隔着海也闻得到。
lines.en: I can smell you even across the water.

lines.zh: 我认下了，接下来只是时间问题。
lines.en: I have accepted it; the rest is only time.

lines.zh: 你要跑就跑，我炮口跟着。
lines.en: Run if you like; the muzzle follows.

lines.zh: 那身甲挡不住一颗实心弹。
lines.en: That armor will not stop a solid shot.

lines.zh: 我把火绳绕上手，慢慢收紧。
lines.en: I wrap the match cord around my hand and draw it tight.

lines.zh: 这一炮我留了很久，给你。
lines.en: I have saved this shot a long while, and it is yours.

lines.zh: 火绳上的火星，一点一点往下去。
lines.en: The spark on the cord creeps down, bit by bit.

lines.zh: 我压住炮身，等它别再晃。
lines.en: I hold the barrel down until it stops swaying.

lines.zh: 你走的每一步，我都在减射程。
lines.en: Every step you take, I shorten the range.

lines.zh: 我屏住气，虽然我早不喘了。
lines.en: I hold my breath, though I stopped breathing long ago.

lines.zh: 炮口压低一寸，正好到你的胸口。
lines.en: The muzzle drops an inch, level with your chest.

lines.zh: 引信响的时候，我什么也不想。
lines.en: When the fuse sounds, I think of nothing.

lines.zh: 你再走两步，就进那条线了。
lines.en: Two more steps and you are on the line.

lines.zh: 我的手指在扳机上停着没动。
lines.en: My finger rests on the trigger without moving.

lines.zh: 这门炮比我诚实，它不会犹豫。
lines.en: The gun is more honest than I am; it does not hesitate.

lines.zh: 我听见自己的心跳，其实是火在烧。
lines.en: I hear my heartbeat, though it is only fire burning.

lines.zh: 我一炮轰过去，沙都被掀起来。
lines.en: I fire, and the sand rises with the blast.

lines.zh: 后坐力把我推退了两步。
lines.en: The recoil shoves me back two steps.

lines.zh: 炮弹落地，你身边的人不见了。
lines.en: The shot lands, and whoever stood beside you is gone.

lines.zh: 我抡起炮架砸下，比开炮还狠。
lines.en: I swing the carriage down harder than any shot.

lines.zh: 铁臂扫过去，你撞在桅杆上。
lines.en: My iron arm sweeps you into the mast.

lines.zh: 炮口早就对准你了。
lines.en: My cannon's been trained on you.

lines.zh: 硝烟里我看不清，可我知道打中了。
lines.en: I cannot see through the smoke, and I know it landed.

lines.zh: 我抬脚踩下，地面先震了一下。
lines.en: I raise a foot and the ground shakes before it lands.

lines.zh: 你一躲，炮口跟着转了半圈。
lines.en: You dodge, and the muzzle tracks half a turn.

lines.zh: 我说过，炮不怕慢。
lines.en: I told you, a gun need not hurry.

lines.zh: 我推着炮从舱底上来，梯子响了一路。
lines.en: I haul the gun up from the hold, and the ladder protests.

lines.zh: 沙滩上先出现影子，然后是炮管。
lines.en: A shadow appears on the beach, then the barrel.

lines.zh: 铁甲一片片扣上，我才站起来。
lines.en: The plates click on one by one before I stand.

lines.zh: 潮水退开，我连炮带人露出来。
lines.en: The tide draws back and reveals me and the gun.

lines.zh: 我落地，周围一圈沙都陷下去。
lines.en: I land, and a ring of sand sinks around me.

lines.zh: 远处有人喊开炮，我就到了。
lines.en: Someone shouts to fire, and I arrive.

lines.zh: 我从破船侧翻出来，压塌半面舱壁。
lines.en: I roll out of the wreck and collapse half a bulkhead.

lines.zh: 火药味先到，我后到。
lines.en: The smell of powder arrives first; I follow.

lines.zh: 我立在浅水里，炮口朝着岸。
lines.en: I stand in the shallows with the muzzle toward shore.

lines.zh: 我那张脸从黑暗里慢慢显出来。
lines.en: My face comes slowly out of the dark.

lines.zh: 火在甲上爬，我先把药包扔出去。
lines.en: Fire climbs my armor, so I throw the charges clear.

lines.zh: 落地时我砸出一个坑，炮还架着。
lines.en: I land in a crater of my own making, gun still mounted.

lines.zh: 水没到炮口，我把它高高举起来。
lines.en: Water reaches the muzzle, so I hold it high.

lines.zh: 自己的药炸了，我耳鸣了半天。
lines.en: My own powder goes off, and my ears ring a long while.

lines.zh: 箭碰在甲上弹开，像敲了一下钟。
lines.en: The arrow rings off my plate like a struck bell.

lines.zh: 那种光钻进铁缝，疼得发麻。
lines.en: That light seeps into the seams and leaves me numb.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，只吃火药和铁。
lines.en: I do not eat; I take powder and iron instead.

lines.zh: 雷落在炮管上，我整个人都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the barrel, and for a moment I glow.

lines.zh: 往下坠时，我还在找炮口的朝向。
lines.en: As I fall, I still try to level the barrel.
